rows.name: 14TH ST GROCERY AND HALAL MEAT (Near Atlanta Airport)
rows.notes: Result URL is a third-party directory (ruspagesusa.com), not the shop's site. Listing and Yelp (May 2026), Apple Maps, Zabihah all show 14th St Grocery and Halal Meat at 398 14th St NW (Home Park). Directory says it carries 'a specialized selection of Mediterranean oils'; olive oil / EVOO not named. Name's 'Near Atlanta Airport' is odd: address is Midtown/Home Park, ~9 mi from the airport. ~1.7 mi from 30308. [reused from eval20-0925, same URL and address]
